application_review: PROGRESS. The preceding convex-hull proof round was rechecked before edits. All retained proof sources and axiom sets remain unchanged.
The new finite law has coefficient p(c)/card(G), with its total and expectation formula proved exactly. The original nonnegative normalized cell weights are retained, including zero-weight cells.
The group, cell type and subgroup may vary at every stage. The construction uses the existing actual finite-mass L2 seminorm and separated completed ultrafilter Hilbert space.

The forward implication transfers the previously proved weighted anti-uniform estimate by squeezing correlations to zero, then extends orthogonality through the linear span and its topological closure.

The converse uses the actual pure dual of the given unit-bounded test family, realizes it as a mixed-dual generator, and identifies its pairing with the dyadic Gowers power. Bounded ultrafilter convergence and uniqueness force the Gowers root limit to zero.

The equivalence requires positive degree, normalized nonnegative cell weights and unit-bounded input for the converse. It holds for any ultrafilter; no unsupported freeness or exchange of limits is used.

Nine theorems, four definitions and one nonnegativity instance are audited. This establishes the actual closed-span orthogonality characterization, not characteristic-factor localization, relative orthogonality of different subgroup factors, higher-order concatenation, or full Bessel.
remaining: The common-system master estimates, first-order Bessel, dual energy reduction, recursion and stability are proved. Actual dual functions now have a common finite empirical approximation preserving arbitrary cell probabilities, unit bounds and uniform bounded-test correlations. Exact arbitrary-vertex reflection of the actual subgroup cube law and mixed products is now proved. Mixed cubes now have exact arbitrary-vertex duality and weighted single-vertex replacement estimates. Finite products of dual functions now have quantitative empirical approximation uniform over bounded tests. Exact translated-product expansions and extraction for each fixed test are now proved. The exact mixed face split, projected-face correlation and one-step face Cauchy-Schwarz inequality are now proved. Face energies are now identified with actual copied cube means, with nonnegativity and copy algebra verified. Arbitrary-coordinate permutation invariance, copied-mean nonnegativity and reflection bounds are now established. Full multidimensional mixed Gowers Cauchy-Schwarz, the product-root bound and the single-vertex bound are now proved. Actual dual anti-uniformity, its weighted version and the finite zero-root orthogonality characterization are now proved. Mixed dual recursion, covariance and exact subgroup-shift expansions are now established. Same-subgroup mixed-dual finite products now have an exact averaged dual representation and retain weighted anti-uniformity. The actual unit-input mixed-dual convex hull now has multiplicative and translation closure with unchanged weighted anti-uniform bounds. For varying finite groups and cell types, the exact weighted Haar Hilbert realization and vanishing-Gowers/closed-dual-span orthogonality equivalence are now proved. Higher-order concatenation controlling dual correlations and the full qualitative Bessel theorem remain missing, as do remaining replica integration, cyclic-to-interval transfer and inverse correlator existence. Coloring-derived targets, Calibration/Alignment and final ordered positive rapidly separated monochromatic extraction remain. StrongConjecture is unchanged and unproved. No unavoidable blocker is established; publication, PR and prize application remain pending.
